subject: Re: ZenWell SOC 2 / security review — post-call recap & next steps
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@zenwellhealth.com>, Priya Singh <psingh@zenwellhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: ZenWell SOC 2 / security review — post-call recap & next steps

Hi Alex / Priya,

Thanks again for the time today — useful conversation and good to understand your compliance priorities. Quick recap of what we heard and proposed next steps so everyone is aligned.

Summary of your goals and pain points
- Primary goal: Serve regulated patient-facing workflows with strict data residency and audit requirements for Q4 launch.
- Pain points: lack of reliable audit logs/retention, manual evidence collection for SOC 2/Risk assessments, and limited ability to prove deletion/scoped retention to customers.
- Compliance drivers: SOC 2 Type 2 evidence, pen test artifacts, DPA with specific retention & deletion SLAs.

What Redwood can provide (high level)
- SOC 2: We can share our latest SOC 2 Type 2 report (attached) and a control matrix mapping.
- Audit logs & retention: Per-route token-level audit logs, configurable retention policies (30 / 90 / 365 days or custom), and exportable log bundles for third-party audits.
- DPA and data flows: We have a standard DPA and can add clauses for retention windows and deletion attestations.
- Pen test evidence: We can provide a redacted pen test summary and our internal remediation timeline.

Action items / next steps
1) Neha: Share SOC 2 report, pen test summary, and the retention CSV by EOD (attached). (Done — see attachments)
2) Alex: Confirm which accounts/environments require 365d retention vs. 90d by Thu 3/31.
3) Priya: Please share any vendor questionnaire templates (e.g., security questionnaire) — we’ll pre-fill and return within 48 hours.
4) Marissa / Rishi: Coordinate a follow-up technical call to walk through audit log exports and DPA redlines. Proposed window: next week (Apr 5–7).

Notes on evidence delivery
- Attachments included in this email: SOC2_Type2_Report_2026.pdf, pen_test_summary_zenwell_2026.pdf, redwood_data_retention_table.csv.
- For sensitive artifacts we’ll provide redacted versions initially and can arrange a secure share (SFTP / secure Drive) for full artifacts under an NDA if needed.

If I missed anything important from today’s call, flag it and I’ll update. Otherwise I’ll schedule the technical follow-up and include the detailed log export walkthrough.

Best,

Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0147

Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ZenWell SOC 2 / security review — post-call recap & next steps

Neha — thanks for the thorough recap and for sending artifacts. Quick follow-ups from our side: 

1) Retention: We need 365d retention for production customer PII logs, and 90d for staging. Can you confirm that per-environment retention policies are supported and whether export bundles can be scoped to env + customer?

2) Audit log details: For our internal auditors we need the following fields in the export: timestamp (UTC), requester identity (OID/Email), request route/model, full request/response hashes, and deletion events including deletion requester and timestamp. Is that in the export?

3) Pen test: The summary looks good — would value the full findings under NDA so our security team can validate mitigations. Can your security team join a short call to walk through the remediation timeline?

Let’s lock the technical call for Apr 6 (Tue) 11:00am PT if that works for your team.

Thanks,
Alex
Director, Security & Compliance | ZenWell Health
alex.johnson@zenwellhealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0199

Hi Alex / Priya — thanks, locking this in and answering your specific questions below.

Per-environment retention and scoping
- Yes, Redwood supports per-environment retention policies. You can set retention at the route or environment level (prod/staging). Export bundles can be scoped by environment and by customer identifier; we’ll include an export filter for customer_id in the CSV export.

Audit log fields
- Export will contain: timestamp_utc, requester_identity (OID + email), route/model, request_id, request/response hash (SHA256), and event_type (create/update/delete). Deletion events include deletion_requester and deletion_timestamp. We can provide a sample export with synthetic data on the call so your auditors can validate format.

Full pen test artifacts and secure share
- We can provide full pen test findings under an NDA / secure link. I’m happy to join the call and walk through remediation status; Rishi (copied) will provide the remediation tracker during the call.

Call invite
- Confirmed: Tue Apr 6, 2027 11:00 AM PT — invite sent (you should have a calendar invite from me).

Deliverables before call
- Marissa: sample export schema + synthetic sample CSV (attached link).
- Rishi: remediation tracker and timeline for pen test items.
- Neha: DPA redline suggestions and example clause for retention/deletion attestations.

If anything changes on your side re: scope or required fields, please update the invite or reply-all. Looking forward to the call.

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Product Manager, Compliance | Redwood Inference
